name: Motion for a resolution (as a whole)
title: JOINT MOTION FOR A RESOLUTION on EU actions against the Russian shadow fleets and ensuring a full enforcement of sanctions against Russia
part_text:
The European Parliament is not changing any law here. It is setting out its opinion and asking the European Union to act harder against Russia's "shadow fleet" — the hundreds of old, often uninsured tankers Russia uses to sell oil and dodge sanctions. The Parliament wants more ships and companies added to the sanctions list, checks on insurance, a ban on transferring Russian oil between ships in EU waters, and better protection against oil spills.

- The Parliament asks for more sanctions on shadow fleet ships, owners and insurers.
- It affects Russia's oil trade, EU ports and coastal countries at risk of spills.
- Next, the EU Commission and member states decide whether to act on these requests.
